title: Autograd Matrix Products and Chain Gradients
prompt:
Implement `MatMul`, a custom `torch.autograd.Function`, and its `matmul(a, b)` wrapper. Inputs are compatible real floating tensors with rank at least two: the final two axes are matrix axes, and leading batch axes may broadcast. Forward must agree with `torch.matmul` for rectangular matrices and broadcast batches; backward must return gradients reduced to the original broadcasted input shapes while preserving dtype and device. One-dimensional vector promotion, complex tensors, and sparse tensors are outside this exercise.

`chain_forward(matrices)` returns only the final left-to-right product of a non-empty sequence of compatible two-dimensional matrices. `chain_backward(matrices, grad_output)` returns one gradient per matrix for the scalar objective `sum(chain_forward(matrices) * grad_output)`, with `grad_output` matching the final product shape. Support rectangular factors and a one-matrix chain; do not mutate caller inputs. This is different from returning every prefix product with a separate upstream gradient for each prefix. Discuss how to reuse partial products in the backward pass; a parallel scan implementation is a discussion follow-up, not a graded callable.

example.reasoning: The inner dimensions contract and the outer dimensions remain.
